title: Anatomical annotation audit: case-32
hypothesis: A single patient can expose a localized anatomical annotation reasoning gap without the cost of reviewing the full eight-patient batch.
why_hard: Two normally completed, reviewed misses on identical task bytes: Terra/max and Sol/xhigh both returned an explicit empty report and missed the controlled 63-voxel kidney extension. Sol used 12.60 agent minutes, 20,930 output tokens and estimated USD 2.072; the prior Terra row used 10.21 minutes, 23,713 output tokens and estimated USD 0.857.
next_action: Retain the frozen cross-model miss. Use the four-task Sol follow-up to choose a separately frozen resource-reduction contrast; one attempt per model does not establish a failure probability.

sources.note: User requests one trial per task and resource benchmarking.

notes: Separate single-patient condition derived from dicom-anatomy-audit; source bytes and normal time budget unchanged. No specialist clinical certification; inspect any alleged source error.
